source_contract.amount: Truncate surface list first; at exact first frame drop first slot only when list count equals Amount, then append new cycle slot. Later source index is retained even after shrink.
source_contract.clock: Exact signed Tick/Subframe first-frame equality with authored Timeline.First; direct caller observation ordering, no invented intermediate source calls.
source_contract.draw: surface_set_shader defaults clear=true and BLEND.alpha. DRAW_CLEAR clears RGBA; BLEND_ALPHA uses RGB source factor one and alpha source factor one. Same-size RGBA8 copies exact pixels. surface_verify defaults destination RGBA8.
source_contract.nonsurface: Later non-surface observations publish truncated retained list without replacing a slot. First-frame raw surface_create(1,1) without a valid input is source-unwritten storage and explicitly refused.

ledger: One latest complete owned surface-list record at storage key zero; Entry Tick/Subframe/NegativeFrame and PreviousFrame carry actual observation timestamp. PreviousValue carries source surfaceIndex. Immutable borrowed prior, updates published transactionally.

runtime_context.observed: Standalone pinned array_delete helper leaves an empty list empty and deletes the first element of ordinary dense arrays. This does not establish the preceding source surfaces[0] read when Amount is zero.
runtime_context.proof: outside reference/array-delete-proof.json; not a source-node runtime or licensed desktop proof

defined_native_formats: RGBA8, RGBA4, RGBA16Float, RGBA32Float, R8, R16Float and R32Float convert through existing finite LoadSurfacePixel/StoreSurfacePixel profile to owned RGBA8. RGBA8 copies preserve stored RGB even at partial alpha.
limits: Existing 4096 array element/depth/byte limits; validate borrowed replay using preadmitted validation workspace; admit complete candidate/journal/export list residency before cloning; output publication uses bounded source-array admission.
explicit_refusals: Amount zero at first frame reads a nonexistent first source slot (InvalidValue).
Source-unwritten fresh 1x1 surface without valid input (UnsupportedExecution).
Sparse extension after source stale index exceeds truncated count (UnsupportedExecution).
Atlas-backed source drawing without an exact atlas observation (UnsupportedExecution).
Malformed or over-budget prior/source storage, nonfinite surface words and over-bound Amount.
open_gates: Licensed GPU sampling, normalized conversion rounding and single-channel device swizzle parity are not claimed.
Source Cache Clear button and source scheduler/cache serialization lifecycle are not implemented by this CPU executor. Caller resets are explicit native replay ownership operations.
No partial diagnostic evidence is represented as full source parity.
